socialRules: One call to action and one tagged link per post.
No participant names, faces, or stories without a signed release. Posts marked needsRelease do not run without one.
Person-first language: 'people leaving treatment or incarceration'.
SCI outcomes carry the line 'measured among Sanctuary participants since July 2025'. Dollar examples say a gift 'may cover'.
Tax credit posts are held until qualifying charity status is confirmed and always end with 'consult your tax advisor'.
Name the relationship: SCI is the nonprofit; Sanctuary Recovery Centers is the licensed treatment partner.

socialPosts.copy:
Treatment may end. The need for support does not.

When someone leaves treatment or incarceration, the clinical care stops. The need for a safe bed, a ride to work, and a valid ID does not. Sanctuary Community Initiative funds that part.

On December 1, Giving Tuesday, we are filling the safety net. More soon. [link]

socialPosts.format: Photo of a van or bus pass
socialPosts.copy:
What does $50 do? It may cover a ride to treatment, court, work, or a medical appointment.

One missed ride can cost someone a job or a court date. One covered ride keeps things moving. That is the safety net. [link]

94% of participants had no new arrests across all check-ins, measured among Sanctuary participants since July 2025.

Stable housing and practical support are what that number is made of. On Giving Tuesday we are raising [goal] to keep it going. [link]

Housing. Transportation. Food and hygiene. Clothing. IDs. Job readiness. Family connection.

Insurance pays for treatment. It does not pay for these. Your gift does. Giving Tuesday is December 1. [link]

[Staff member, in their own words, on why they do this work.]

Nine in ten of our staff have lived experience in recovery. They know what it takes to rebuild. One week until Giving Tuesday. Help us be there for the next person. [link]

The best reentry program is the one no one ends up needing.

A missed rent payment, no transportation, no ID: small problems become big ones fast. We step in early so they do not. [link]

Grateful today for every partner, donor, and neighbor who helps people in Maricopa and Pinal counties stay housed, working, and connected. Happy Thanksgiving from all of us at Sanctuary Community Initiative.

$25 may cover food, hygiene, or transportation essentials for someone starting over.

Giving Tuesday is four days away. Every gift goes into one shared safety net. [link]
Two days. Our Giving Tuesday goal is [goal], and most of every dollar goes to transition housing: a safe place to sleep while someone rebuilds. [link]

Tomorrow is Giving Tuesday.

Sanctuary started more than twenty years ago as a single house. The idea has not changed: give someone a stable place to stand and they can do the rest. Tomorrow, help us fill the safety net. [link]

I started Sanctuary as one house, after living through homelessness myself. I learned that treatment is only part of it. What happens after, the bed, the ride, the ID, the job, decides whether it lasts.

That is why we built Sanctuary Community Initiative. Tomorrow is Giving Tuesday, and I am asking you to help us fill the safety net. [link]

It is Giving Tuesday. Treatment may end. The need for support does not.

Give today and help fund beds, rides, IDs, and a path back to work. [link]

socialPosts.copy:
Arizona lets you decide where part of your state tax bill goes. Give to a qualifying charity and you may claim a dollar-for-dollar credit: up to $506 for single filers and $1,009 for couples filing jointly for 2026.

Sanctuary Community Initiative is a qualifying charity, code [QCO code]. Your credit can fund housing and rides for people rebuilding after treatment or incarceration. Consult your tax advisor. [link]

A credit is not a deduction. A deduction lowers the income you are taxed on. A credit comes straight off what you owe Arizona. Ask your tax preparer about the charitable tax credit, and tell them code [QCO code]. Consult your tax advisor. [link]

Where your tax credit goes: 94% of Sanctuary participants had no new arrests across all check-ins since July 2025. That is what stable housing and practical support do. Redirect your Arizona taxes to it. Consult your tax advisor. [link]
Three steps. 1: Give to Sanctuary Community Initiative by April 15. 2: Keep your receipt. 3: Claim the credit on Arizona Form 321 with code [QCO code]. Consult your tax advisor. [link]
